name: code-intel
description: Go-to-definition, find-references, hover and the file outline in the side panel's code editor, answered by language servers the gateway runs for the project: one per language and project root, started from the Language servers tab and stopped with the gateway. Nothing is installed for you: it finds the servers already on the machine (pyright, typescript-language-server, gopls, rust-analyzer, jdtls, clangd, solargraph) and says which command would add a missing one.
author: kirocrew
highlights: F12 goes to a symbol's definition, Shift+F12 lists its references, Alt+F12 shows its documentation, Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+O outlines the file; Cmd/Ctrl+click is go-to-definition
Answers follow unsaved edits: the editor's text is sent only when the server's copy is behind, and only because this app holds the editor-text permission
The Language servers tab shows every server the gateway runs, starts or stops them, searches symbols across them and outlines the project's files
Library sources: a Java definition inside a jar is written out from the server and opened like any file
Runs only the servers already installed on this machine, under the gateway's own sandbox wrapper; nothing is downloaded

panelTabs.title: Language servers
panelTabs.menuDescription: The language servers running for this project, symbol search across them, and the files' outlines.

useCases: Read a codebase in the side panel the way an IDE shows it: jump to where a name is defined, see every place it is used, and read a symbol's documentation without leaving the chat.
configuration: Off until you enable it on this page. Then open the Language servers tab from the side panel's + menu to start a server for the project; the shortcuts work once one is running for the file's language. Change them in Settings → Shortcuts → Editor shortcuts.
